    """Analytical Jacobian for the Robertson problem."""
    y1, y2, y3 = y
    k1 = 0.04
    k2 = 1e-4
    k3 = 3e-7
    
    J = np.array([
        [-k1, 0, 0],
        [k1, -(k2*y1 + k3), 0],
        [0, k2*y1, k3]
